name: Terminal
author: AirOne-dev
description: Slack as a phosphor terminal: monospace everywhere, zero rounded corners, hairline borders, amber and green on near-black. Square avatars included.

descriptions.fr: Slack en terminal à phosphore : monospace partout, aucun coin arrondi, bordures d'un cheveu, ambre et vert sur presque-noir. Avatars carrés compris.
